head: 954d13185e26a1ed90f6d7c60f6ba27760ca9889
classification: Measured preexisting label-selector cardinality defect, independent of Circle and Context cache. Internal language parity correction needs owner L0 first; no additional public contract.
observations: Two direct metadata values without Context returned only first for repeated label; pinned oracle returned both.
Shared and distinct Circle, generic Rect and text all lose second value only through repeated-label selector.
Different labels queried as metadata return correct40pt and80pt, proving Circle radius late resolution in both occurrences.

cause.finding: Selector::Label calls query_by_label whose compatibility contract returns first only; LabelRegistry already has complete lookup_all index.

l0.finding: Selectors preserve causal order and Location identity; no current single-result restriction.

limits: Keep query_by_label legacy first-result contract and public signatures unchanged.
Do not modify frozen224case policy or unrelated Context timing/style/default mechanics.
Legacy query_helpers::query_elements remains outside this compiled CLI path; no need to broaden this correction.
Combined-scope set-text context control has unrelated style semantics and is exploratory, not new acceptance.
